subject.title: fix(sessions): bound AGENTS.md and prompt-input file reads with size cap

question: Should session startup intentionally skip existing `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` files larger than 1 MiB, rather than preserve, truncate, or migrate their current unbounded behavior?
rationale: This is an upgrade-visible prompt-context policy choice, not a mechanical safety detail: the proposed warning still changes which instructions reach the model for existing projects.

options.title: Bound explicit prompt files only
options.body: Keep the 10 MiB cap for user-supplied and discovered system-prompt files, but preserve the current project-context contract until a dedicated context-policy change is approved.

options.title: Approve the 1 MiB context limit
options.body: Accept skipping oversized project instructions, provided the short-read bug is fixed and the upgrade behavior is explicitly documented and tested.

options.title: Choose a different context policy
options.body: Define a maintained truncation or larger-cap policy for project instructions before merging the helper into that call path.

recommendation.title: Bound explicit prompt files only
recommendation.body: Keep the 10 MiB cap for user-supplied and discovered system-prompt files, but preserve the current project-context contract until a dedicated context-policy change is approved.

likelyOwner.reason: The available related-history signal connects this person to the PR's review/CI path, but session-area ownership should be confirmed before deciding the user-visible context policy.
